messages:
Devon: quick design prob — when our auto-fallback kicks in the console shows an `AutoFallback` event but operators keep asking: what exactly changed, who/what triggered it, and can I roll it back safely? :thinking:
Ava: agreed. we surface the event but not the pre/post routing snapshot. ops need a fast way to preview the rollback impact (model, route, quant profile).
Sam: UX idea — add a slim 'Rollback preview' drawer that shows 'before' and 'after' diffs and a sample of affected request traces (with opt-in PII scrub). simple confirm button.
Riley: two red flags: (1) noise for auto-alerts causing accidental rollbacks, (2) permission model — only prod-ops should hit rollback. we need rate-limiting + RBAC.
Nadia: + audit logs retention. customers will ask for immutable evidence: who clicked rollback, what was the policy state, and payloads. add policy-id + rollout-id to the event so it can be reconciled in logs.
Devon: +1 on metadata. thinking minimal API change: add `rollout_snapshot` and `trigger_metadata` to the auto-fallback webhook/console event. sample payload: 
```json
{
  "event_type": "auto_fallback",
  "policy_id": "pol_ABC123",
  "rollout_id": "roll_2026-07-01T15:00Z",
  "trigger_metadata": {"error_rate": 0.12, "latency_p90_ms": 1400},
  "rollout_snapshot": {"routes_before": ["v1"], "routes_after": ["v1-degraded"]}
}
```
Ava: seems fine. for the UI show top-line KPIs and a condensed list of 10 sample traces (link to trace view). make traces clickable to open the full trace in the tracing UI.
Sam: also add a 'dry-run' toggle in the preview that simulates traffic routing for 1 minute without changing live routing — show estimated QPS affected. Might reuse existing simulation infra.
Riley: dry-run is helpful but expensive. we should default to a light sample (0.1% of matched traffic) and show estimated cost. ops can increase sample if they need deeper confidence.
Nadia: audit considerations: we should store the rollout_snapshot as an immutable blob in the audit store and surface a signed reference in the event so legal/compliance can fetch it later. retention configurable per org.
Devon: permissions model proposal: `rollout:preview` for viewing, `rollout:simulate` for dry-run, `rollout:execute` for actual rollback. tie to SSO groups.
Ava: small UI copy note — call the action 'Initiate contingency rollback' not just 'Rollback' to reduce accidental clicks. show a 2-step confirm and require an ops ticket number.
Sam: +1, add a small keyboard shortcut and an undo TTL (30s) where operators can cancel the rollback if they hit it by mistake. show the diff during TTL.
Riley: logging: emit a structured event when undo is used: `rollback_undo` with actor + reason. also increment a counter to detect accidental UX triggers.
Nadia: regulatory: for some customers we should offer 'no-operator-rollback' mode where the system automatically falls back but only auto-heals back after human review. flag per-tenant.
Devon: all great. action items: (1) API change PR to add `rollout_snapshot` + `trigger_metadata` (Nadia + Dev), (2) Console mockups for preview/dry-run/confirm (Sam + Ava), (3) RBAC + audit blob storage plan (Riley + Nadia). can we target a small spike next week?
Ava: I can do the mockups Tue/Wed.
Riley: I'll draft the RBAC matrix and how it maps to SSO groups this week.
Nadia: I'll prototype the audit blob flow and retention flags — will need storage estimate.
Devon: thanks. small follow-up: should deploy-bot include the rollout_id in deploy notifications so SRE can correlate?
deploy-bot: automatic update — new field `meta.rollout_id` added to internal deploy webhook as of 1791112300.
Devon: perfect, that'll help. last q: any objections to a 0.1% default dry-run sample?
Riley: fine by me. monitor cost and errors for the first 48h.
Sam: :thumbsup:
Ava: :rocket:
Nadia: noted.
Devon: ok closing this thread — will open a tracking RFC and assign owners. thanks everyone!
